context: Daichi and Mei laugh about a wasted errand.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (再び/なんだか/びっくり/無駄/いきなり) in natural home.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 今日な、いきなり店が閉まっとってん。
lines.en: Today the shop was suddenly closed.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えっ、びっくりしましたね。
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: わざわざ行ったのに、無駄足やったわ。
lines.en: I went all that way, and it was a wasted trip.
lines.style: rueful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: なんだか、ついてない日でしたね。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 明日、再び行ってみるわ。
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 再び閉まってたら、笑えますね。
lines.en: If it's closed again, that'd be funny.
lines.style: playful woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: いきなり休みやと、困るわー。
lines.en: A sudden closure is a pain.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 無駄にならないこと、祈ってます。
lines.en: I hope it won't be in vain.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
